description: Dr Amandeep Hansra: Chief Clinical Adviser, Australian Digital Health Agency; medical repatriation and aviation medicine experience. Mark Hallam: aerospace engineer, ATC project manager; leads our build. A/Prof Eugene Wong: retrieval doctor; Deputy Director, QLD Virtual Emergency Care Service. Dr Raymond Wen: Medical Director, Telecare Australia; designs and delivers life-saving remote models of care, an Earth analogue for space medicine. Arki Prasad: aspiring astronaut and crew physician.
